name: Bariloche
tagline: Alpine lakes, chocolate and Patagonian peaks
summary: Bariloche sits on Nahuel Huapi Lake in Argentina's Lake District, with Alpine-style chalets, chocolate shops and mountains all around. Drive the Circuito Chico, ride to Cerro Campanario's view, ski Cerro Catedral in winter and cruise to Isla Victoria.
seasonNote: December to March is hiking and lake season; July and August are ski season.
arrival: Bariloche Airport is 20 minutes away; flights from Buenos Aires take 2 hours.
gettingAround: Buses along Avenida Bustillo; rent a car for lakes.
cashTip: Argentine prices and exchange rules change quickly; treat peso prices as rough guides. Cards work widely; foreign cards often get a favourable rate.
baseArea: Centro or along the lake road
